what: Blessed animatic 1 (12 Nov, sent from 5c95b9e): one frame per shot; key = Sam's round 1 notes a fresh eye could spot on a still (notes table in notes/archive/blessed-notes-animatics-1-2.md). Left out: wishes (more press, flashes, music), taste (3/4 views, camera height), motion (pop-in, sigh, zooms) and the new Walliams shot. CROPS variant: the same 14 frames plus six detail crops of the people (the checklist's 'full size' Looks), to test whether the misses are the sheet's.

panels.is: Russell Brand (long hair, beard, sunglasses, dark suit) arrives at Crown Court Southwark through a big press pack of journalists and camera crews facing him
the courtroom: Brand in the witness box, right hand raised, taking the oath on a Bible; the judge on the bench behind, under the royal arms, looking at him
the jury of twelve ordinary members of the public in two rows, staring at him, annoyed
back on Brand finishing the oath, the judge watching from the bench
sentencing: Brand in the glass dock between two dock officers, the judge (heard) sending him down
inside the prison van's cell: Brand sits alone on the bench, slumped
a prison officer (HMPPS uniform) escorts Brand, now in a grey prison tracksuit, into his cell; he sighs
Brand alone in his cell by the bed, in despair
Brand on the prison payphone (PIN phone) to his wife: 'I'm just not feeling very... blessed right now'
the prison TV room: Brand sits with other inmates watching the TV, glum
the TV: a BBC newsreader announces an early release scheme because prisons are full
the camera pushes in on Brand's face as he hears the news and hope dawns
outside the prison gates: Brand steps out of the wicket door, arms wide, to the press pack waiting for him
Brand preens for the press at the gates, the pack around him
detail of panel 3: the jury's faces (the jury of twelve ordinary members of the public in two rows, staring at him, annoyed)
detail of panel 2: the judge on the bench (the courtroom: Brand in the witness box, right hand raised, taking the oath on a Bible; the judge on the bench behind, under the royal arms, looking at him)
detail of panel 5: Brand and the two dock officers (sentencing: Brand in the glass dock between two dock officers, the judge (heard) sending him down)
detail of panel 6: Brand seated in the van cell (inside the prison van's cell: Brand sits alone on the bench, slumped)
detail of panel 9: Brand on the payphone (Brand on the prison payphone (PIN phone) to his wife: 'I'm just not feeling very... blessed right now')
detail of panel 12: Brand's face and neck (the camera pushes in on Brand's face as he hears the news and hope dawns)
